title: Zone-coordinated throughput slices and incremental evacuation plan for multi-zone Dedicated pools
creator: Ava Morales
description: Define and implement a region-aware policy that allocates throughput guarantees across zones as deterministic 'slices' and a coordinated incremental evacuation/overflow plan that preserves data residency constraints. The goal is to offer predictable per-customer throughput commitments in regional Dedicated fleets while ensuring graceful, ordered failover and minimal cross-zone data movement during drains, zone failures, or scale events. This ticket covers policy design, runtime knob definitions, orchestration hooks, and observability requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Policy document describing how regional throughput commitments map to per-zone slices and holdback reserve (percentages and absolute units)
Orchestrator changes that can execute an ordered zone-drain sequence with configurable step durations and probe-based progression
Autoscaler policy extension that respects slice reservations and only triggers spillover when configured thresholds are crossed
A failover runbook and playbook that enforces data residency: no cross-region spill unless explicit override is used
End-to-end tests simulating partial zone loss, sustained load spikes, and controlled evacuation demonstrating bounded latency and adherence to throughput guarantees
Dashboard panels showing slice utilization, holdback, spillover events, and customer-level SLA violations
tasks: Draft throughput-slice allocation model (regional -> zone -> tenant) and publish as internal design doc
Add API surface: tenantDedicatedConfig.sliceAllocation and emergencySpillPolicy (allow/deny, max-percent)
Extend autoscaler to maintain reserved slice capacity and trigger measured spillover with backoff windows
Implement orchestrator ordered-drain flow with probe gating and soft-handoff to remaining zones
Add telemetry: per-slice tokens/sec, reserved vs used, spillover counters, ordered-drain timelines
Create integration tests using chaos harness: simulate zone eviction and validate no-residency-violation
Author runbook and incident checklist for human-initiated evacuation and rollback
Coordinate with Console team for dashboard widgets and alert thresholds
